decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the options based on sound quality ratings, brand reliability, and portability. The JBL Flip 5 is the clear leader in rating (4.8) and is a well-known reliable model with excellent reviews regarding sound quality and build. I also considered the more portable JBL Clip 3 and some feature-rich budget options like the XENEO X21 and TENMIYA 30W speaker, but ultimately decided to invest in the superior sound profile of the Flip 5. Several items in the feed were disregarded as they were accessories (cases, cables, straps) rather than actual speakers.
